methodology: We analyzed 40+ Reddit posts and 250+ comments across r/AusBeer, r/melbourne, r/CraftBeer, and r/australia — spanning 2022 to 2026. Venues were cross-referenced with beer-industry publications (The Crafty Pint, Froth, Brews News) and local guides. We weighted responses from Melbourne locals and craft beer regulars more heavily than tourist one-offs, and excluded permanently closed venues.
